protocol_metadata.title: ISL Robustness Improvement Experiment Protocol (Existing-Data Constraint)
protocol_metadata.governance_note: Prepared under strict non-execution audit constraints. All hypotheses, training data allowances, validation pools, leakage controls, acceptance criteria, and falsification conditions are declared prior to any experimental trial. No cherry-picking, post-hoc metric alteration, or unauthorized holdout use is permitted.

permitted_training_pool.restriction: Training pool only. Strictly forbidden from validation reuse.

permitted_training_pool.source: data/extracted_frames/signer_04 (Letters A-M Condition 1, Letters N-Z Condition 2)
permitted_training_pool.restriction: Development training partition. Zero recording overlap with signer_04_val.

permitted_development_validation_pool.source: data/extracted_frames/signer_04 (Letters A-M Condition 2, Letters N-Z Condition 1)
permitted_development_validation_pool.restriction: Valid for evaluating same-signer recording-disjoint and cross-condition robustness only. Explicitly labeled as previously exposed development data. MUST NOT be claimed as an unseen-signer test.

strictly_prohibited_data.reason: Phase 19 frozen benchmark. Prior exposure in Phases 14-23 influenced model and threshold choices. Strictly prohibited from training, tuning, or augmentation design.
Phase 19 frozen benchmark. Co-exposed with signer_02. Strictly quarantined.
Evaluated in Phase 30 and forensically analyzed in Phase 31. Not pristine. Strictly prohibited from training, feature engineering, scaler fitting, or hyperparameter search.

semantic_augmentation_guidelines.isl_linguistic_constraints: Indian Sign Language (ISL) utilizes distinctive two-handed and single-handed configurations where spatial orientation, finger curling, thumb opposition, and handedness are phonemically contrastive. Arbitrary transformations can alter or invert sign meaning.

permitted_transformations.parameter_bounds: Gaussian noise N(0, sigma^2) with sigma <= 0.004 normalized coordinates
permitted_transformations.semantic_impact: Simulates minor sensor jitter and tremor without modifying finger joint angle topology.

permitted_transformations.parameter_bounds: theta in [-6.0 deg, +6.0 deg] around palm normal
permitted_transformations.semantic_impact: Models slight wrist tilt; strictly bounded to prevent confusing signs distinguished by vertical vs horizontal orientation (e.g., C vs U or pointing signs).

permitted_transformations.parameter_bounds: scale factor s in [0.95, 1.05] centered on hand centroid
permitted_transformations.semantic_impact: Models slight hand size differences without distorting relative aspect ratios.

strictly_prohibited_transformations.reason: Swaps left and right hand identities and inverts asymmetric two-handed ISL signs (e.g. dominant vs base hand roles).
Inverts pointing direction, turning upward-pointing signs into non-signs or entirely different symbols.
Rotations > 10 degrees collapse phonemic orientation distinctions (e.g., M vs W, or horizontal vs vertical palm orientations).
Violates kinematic skeletal constraints and anatomical finger-length relationships.

experiment_staged_plan.name: Model C Baseline Reproduction on Clean Recording-Disjoint Split
experiment_staged_plan.hypothesis: Training Model C (280-dim feature vector, Random Forest with 300 estimators, max_depth=14, min_samples_leaf=2, random_state=42) strictly on signer_01 (3,077 frames) + signer_04_train (809 frames) and evaluating on recording-disjoint signer_04_val (812 frames) establishes an unaugmented, leakage-safe baseline.
experiment_staged_plan.training_data: signer_01 (3,077) + signer_04_train (809 frames from 27 recordings: A-M Cond 1, N-Z Cond 2)
experiment_staged_plan.validation_data: signer_04_val (812 frames from 27 recordings: A-M Cond 2, N-Z Cond 1)
secondary_metrics: Condition 1 vs Condition 2 validation subset accuracy
leakage_controls: Strict recording-level partition: zero shared recordings between train and val
Zero signer_01 frames in validation pool
StandardScaler fit exclusively on training split; applied to validation via transform()
experiment_staged_plan.comparison_baseline: Reference baseline for all subsequent experiments.
experiment_staged_plan.predeclared_acceptance_criteria: signer_04_val Macro-F1 >= 75.0% and Balanced Accuracy >= 75.0% with zero runtime exceptions.
experiment_staged_plan.falsification_conditions: Validation Macro-F1 < 70.0% or detection of recording ID overlap between train and val partitions.

experiment_staged_plan.name: Semantic-Preserving Training-Only Geometric Augmentation
experiment_staged_plan.hypothesis: Applying conservative, semantic-preserving landmark perturbations (Gaussian jitter sigma <= 0.004, in-plane tilt theta in [-6 deg, +6 deg], and uniform scale s in [0.95, 1.05]) exclusively to training data will broaden tree split robustness against viewpoint tilt and improve validation macro-F1 on unaugmented cross-condition recordings by >= 1.5%.
experiment_staged_plan.training_data: signer_01 + signer_04_train (with 1x or 2x synthetic perturbation passes applied to training samples)
experiment_staged_plan.primary_metric: Delta in Macro-Averaged F1 on signer_04_val relative to EXP-01 baseline
leakage_controls: Validation partition remains 100% untouched and unaugmented
Augmentations adhere to ISL semantic preservation bounds; no horizontal/vertical flips
experiment_staged_plan.comparison_baseline: Direct comparison against EXP-01 baseline model.
experiment_staged_plan.predeclared_acceptance_criteria: signer_04_val Macro-F1 improves by >= +1.5% (absolute) over EXP-01 without degrading any individual letter recall below 50.0%.
experiment_staged_plan.falsification_conditions: Validation Macro-F1 change is <= 0.0% or any class recall degrades by >= 5.0% relative to EXP-01.

experiment_staged_plan.name: Class Balancing and Cost-Sensitive Weight Sensitivity
experiment_staged_plan.hypothesis: Applying balanced subsample class weighting (class_weight='balanced_subsample') in the Random Forest compensates for slight letter frequency imbalances in signer_01/signer_04 training pools and raises recall on historically low-sample letters without degrading overall macro-F1.
secondary_metrics: Minimum per-letter recall across all 26 classes
leakage_controls: Weights computed strictly from training label distribution; validation distribution never accessed
experiment_staged_plan.predeclared_acceptance_criteria: Minimum per-letter recall increases by >= +5.0% (absolute) with overall macro-F1 dropping by no more than 0.5%.
experiment_staged_plan.falsification_conditions: Overall top-1 accuracy drops by > 2.0% or minority letter recall fails to improve.

experiment_staged_plan.name: Controlled Feature Group Ablation and Invariance Analysis
experiment_staged_plan.hypothesis: Systematically ablating un-rotated camera-frame coordinate features (126 features) in favor of intrinsic translation/rotation-invariant inter-joint angles and normalized pairwise distances will reduce camera perspective sensitivity and improve Condition 2 (lateral angle) validation score.

ablation_subsets.Subset_C_Invariant_Only: 154-dim (Ablating 126 camera-frame coordinates, keeping only intrinsic angles, aspect ratios, and relative distances)

leakage_controls: Feature definitions pre-specified; scalers fit exclusively on training subset
experiment_staged_plan.predeclared_acceptance_criteria: Subset C or D achieves equal or higher Macro-F1 on Condition 2 than Subset A, with <= 60% of feature dimensions.
experiment_staged_plan.falsification_conditions: Ablating coordinates degrades Condition 2 macro-F1 by > 3.0%.

experiment_staged_plan.name: Confidence Calibration and Selective Rejection Protocol
experiment_staged_plan.hypothesis: Fitting an isotonic regression probability calibrator on out-of-fold training predictions enables an optimal confidence rejection threshold tau that filters low-confidence ambiguous predictions, elevating precision on accepted predictions to >= 90.0% with coverage >= 80.0%.
experiment_staged_plan.training_data: signer_01 + signer_04_train (using 5-fold cross-validation on training data to generate out-of-fold probability estimates for calibration)
experiment_staged_plan.primary_metric: Risk-Coverage Curve (Accuracy vs Rejection Threshold tau)
leakage_controls: Calibrator fit solely on out-of-fold training predictions; signer_04_val is evaluated strictly in single-pass forward mode
experiment_staged_plan.comparison_baseline: Uncalibrated Random Forest predict_proba() outputs from EXP-01.
experiment_staged_plan.predeclared_acceptance_criteria: Accepted subset achieves top-1 accuracy >= 90.0% at coverage >= 80.0%, and ECE reduces by >= 30% compared to raw RF probabilities.
experiment_staged_plan.falsification_conditions: Coverage falls below 70.0% to achieve 85.0% accuracy, or calibration fails to reduce Brier score.

experiment_staged_plan.name: Per-Letter Error Forensics and Confusion Cluster Characterization
experiment_staged_plan.hypothesis: Pairwise confusion matrix decomposition on recording-disjoint validation frames will identify specific structural confusion clusters (e.g., finger-curl ambiguity or thumb-tuck ambiguity) that are amenable to specialized decision trees or geometric disambiguation rules.
experiment_staged_plan.primary_metric: Pairwise class confusion counts and per-letter recall distribution
leakage_controls: All analyses executed strictly on signer_04_val. Prohibited from inspecting signer_05 confusion patterns to guide heuristic rules.
experiment_staged_plan.predeclared_acceptance_criteria: Clear quantification of top confusion pairs on signer_04_val with >= 3 distinct clusters identified.
experiment_staged_plan.falsification_conditions: Errors are uniformly distributed with no identifiable confusion clusters.

experiment_staged_plan.name: Pipeline Latency, Memory Footprint, and CPU Profile Verification
experiment_staged_plan.hypothesis: Executing the candidate pipeline on macOS Apple Silicon CPU delegate with native resolution preserves runtime budget: p95 latency < 100 ms, throughput > 15 FPS, and zero memory leaks over 1,000 frames.
experiment_staged_plan.validation_data: 1,000 frames stream replay from development dataset
experiment_staged_plan.predeclared_acceptance_criteria: p95 latency <= 100.0 ms, throughput >= 15.0 FPS, memory delta <= 10 MB over 1,000 consecutive frames.
experiment_staged_plan.falsification_conditions: p95 latency > 100.0 ms or memory leak detected.
